tasks.purpose: 比较四个社区图书馆的使用情况
tasks.setting:
The table gives information about four community libraries in one town in 2022. It shows the number of registered users, the number of books lent and the average number of hours that each library opened per week. The figures are for the same calendar year.

Table: community library use in 2022
Library   Users (2022)   Loans (2022)   Hours/week (2022)
North             1200           8400                  40
South              900           7200                  35
East              1500           9000                  45
West               600           4800                  30
bullets: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
must: 概括四馆的主要特征，并选择数据比较使用情况。
tasks.model:
The table compares four community libraries in a town in 2022 in terms of registered users, annual book loans and average weekly opening hours.

Overall, East was the largest of the four libraries by both users and loans, and it was also open for the longest period each week. West had the lowest figure on all three measures. The libraries ranked in the same order across the three indicators.

East had 1,500 registered users, 300 more than North, which had 1,200. South followed with 900, while West had 600 users, less than half the East figure. The number of loans was also highest at East, at 9,000, although North was close behind with 8,400. South recorded 7,200 loans, and West recorded 4,800, just over half the number at East.

The opening hours showed a smaller absolute spread. East opened for an average of 45 hours per week, compared with 40 at North. South opened for 35 hours, five more than West. Thus the difference between the longest and shortest weekly opening times was 15 hours.

tasks.purpose: 比较四个社区运动中心的使用情况
tasks.setting:
The table presents information about four community sports centres during 2023. It compares their numbers of registered members and weekly classes, together with their average opening hours per week. All four centres are in the same town and the membership figures relate to the end of the year.

Table: community sports centres in 2023
Centre   Members (2023)   Classes/week (2023)   Hours/week (2023)
Hill                800                    20                  50
Park               1200                    30                  60
River              1000                    25                  55
Vale                600                    15                  45
bullets: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
must: 概括四个中心的主要特征，并选择数据比较使用情况。
tasks.model:
The table provides data on membership, weekly classes and average weekly opening hours at four community sports centres in 2023. The centres were all located in the same town.

Overall, Park had the most members and classes and opened for the longest time. Vale had the lowest figure for each indicator. River and Hill occupied the middle positions, with River ahead of Hill on all three measures.

At the end of the year, Park had 1,200 registered members, twice the 600 recorded at Vale. River had 1,000 members, placing it 200 below Park and 200 above Hill, whose membership stood at 800. The number of weekly classes followed the same order: Park offered 30 and River 25, compared with 20 at Hill and 15 at Vale.

Park was open for an average of 60 hours a week, while Vale opened for 45 hours. The two other centres fell between these figures, at 55 hours for River and 50 for Hill. Consequently, the gap between neighbouring centres was five hours in each case, and the total range was 15 hours.
